turns.user: A seed-tray card says at least eight seedlings. Eleven seedlings are in the tray. Someone wants the card changed to exactly eight. What does a literal reading keep?
turns.thinking: Eleven meets a floor of eight. Exactly eight would shrink the tray.
turns.reply: I keep eleven. At least eight is a floor, and eleven still meets it.

turns.reply: I stop the crate. Up to 40 kg does not stretch to 55 kg.

turns.reply: I include Wednesday. Every weekday names that day, and the first bell is the start the sign prints.
